tools.name: program_info
tools.description: ApplyReef partner program: 25% commission including renewals (recruiter layer: partners can recruit creators, who earn 15% while the recruiter earns a 15% override on the same customer payments; two levels only, nothing paid for recruiting), crypto payouts once each customer's payment has cleared in

tools.name: plans
tools.description: Live ApplyReef plans and prices (what a partner's audience would buy).

tools.name: my_link
tools.description: Your tracked ApplyReef link and how to use it. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: my_stats
tools.description: Follow your link's performance: clicks, unique visitors, sign-ups, sales, renewals, commission earned, paid out and balance owed, plus recent events. Needs your secret partner token. No customer details are shared.

tools.name: my_visitors
tools.description: Visitor stats for your partner link: unique visitors today, last 7 and 30 days and all time, visitors per day, where they came from (X, YouTube, Instagram, newsletters, direct), the pages they landed on, phone vs computer, typical time on site, and the funnel from visit to sign-up to paid order. Bot

tools.name: my_leads
tools.description: Every lead you've sent, as it moves through ApplyReef: signed up, paid (plan), applications being sent (count so far), renewals, the commission each one earned, and whether that commission has been paid out to you yet. Each lead is a private code, never a name or email. Pass since to see only what's

tools.name: my_payouts
tools.description: Payouts sent to you (date, amount, coin, network, transaction hash and a block-explorer link to verify it on-chain), your payout requests and whether each has been paid, the wallet on file, and what is owed to you now. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: draft_promo
tools.description: Writes a short post, email or script promoting ApplyReef with your tracked link, using only ApplyReef's real facts and an affiliate disclosure.

tools.name: request_payout
tools.description: Ask for your earned commission to be paid in the crypto of your choice. ApplyReef pays once each customer's payment has cleared in Stripe and passed a 60-day hold (the refund and chargeback window). This records the request; it does not move money by itself.

tools.name: join_partner_program
tools.description: Instantly makes the person an ApplyReef partner (free to join): 25% of every payment from customers they refer (15% if they join under a recruiter with via, and the recruiter then earns a 15% override), renewals included, paid in their choice of crypto once each payment has cleared in Stripe and pas

tools.name: recruit_link
tools.description: Your recruit link: creators who join through it are added under you. Each earns 15% of every payment from their customers and you earn a 15% override on the same payments (held 60 days, taken back on refunds). Nothing is paid for recruiting itself; joining is free. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: create_creator_partner
tools.description: Creates a partner account for a creator you recruited, under you: returns their tracked link, private partner page and private AI connector to hand to them. They earn 15% of every payment from their customers and you earn a 15% override on the same payments. No email is sent. Needs your secret partn

tools.name: bulk_create_creator_partners
tools.description: Adds up to 50 creators under you in one call (200 per day). Duplicates by email or handle are skipped. Returns each creator's link, private partner page and private connector to hand to them. No emails are sent. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: my_network
tools.description: Every creator you recruited: clicks, visitors, sign-ups, orders, what their customers paid, their commission, and your override from them (on hold vs cleared the 60-day hold). Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: nominate_creator_pass
tools.description: Files a request for a free 1,000-application creator pass for one of your creators. Passes are only for college-student creators and are issued by the ApplyReef team after review; this never creates one by itself. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: rotate_my_token
tools.description: Turns off your current private partner page and AI connector and gives you new ones; the old token stops working at once. Do it if anyone else has seen your links, for example a recruiter who set up your account (until then, payout-wallet changes are locked on such accounts). Your public link stays

tools.name: my_dashboard
tools.description: The link to your private ApplyReef dashboard: customer flow (clicks to sign-ups to paid to applying), payment timeline (every commission with its hold date, what's available, payouts), your monthly goals with pace, and your creators if you recruit. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: set_goals
tools.description: Sets your own monthly targets (sign-ups, paid customers, commission earned, link clicks). Your dashboard shows progress and a simple pace. Goals are for you; they are not forecasts or promises. Needs your secret partner token.

tools.name: apply_to_partner
tools.description: Send an application for review (for custom terms or large audiences). For the standard 25% program, use join_partner_program instead: it sets the person up instantly.

tools.name: my_content
tools.description: Custom content ApplyReef serves to you: ready-to-post copy, offers, assets and notes made for your audience, plus the shared partner pack.

tools.name: set_payout_wallet
tools.description: Required to get paid: the crypto wallet ApplyReef pays your commission to, once each customer's payment has cleared in Stripe and passed a 60-day hold (the refund and chargeback window). You can change it any time. Accounts a recruiter set up must rotate their token first (rotate_my_token).

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: Reach the ApplyReef team: custom commission terms, custom content for your audience, payouts, bigger partnerships or anything else. Partners connected with their private URL are identified automatically.
